messages:
maria_cs: Heads up: HelixPharm (Alejandra) is expanding beyond R&D. Compliance wants KMS + audit trails; asking about Private/Dedicated pilot and costs.
alejandra_helix: Yep. Were moving from 1 team to 4 (safety, clinical ops, regulatory, data). Expect baseline ~120 qps embeddings, peaks ~500-600 qps. Need KMS + 2y audit retention for auditors.
sanjay_se: Clarify residency? EU/US? SLA target?
alejandra_helix: US only. SLA: <150ms median for small gens, but throughput is priority.
jen_eng: Proposed pilot: Dedicated pods + VPC peering + KMS. Infra ~10 business days, validation 1 week. Recommend 3 pods + burst reserve to handle 600 qps.
ops_oncall: Deploy-bot created ticket INFRA-6821. ETA ~10bd :white_check_mark:
maria_cs: Action: Sanjay to send pricing delta for Dedicated+KMS; Jen to post runbook; Ill schedule kickoff with Helix compliance. Pilot funding?
alejandra_helix: We will fund pilot. If KMS/audits work, high chance of multi-year contract.
maria_cs: Strong expansion signal (4 teams + dedicated). I'll note in account health and renewal watch.
